postconditions.description: The function returns a TreeNode which is the root of the BST created from the sorted linked list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in traverse_preorder(return_value))
postconditions.description: The preorder traversal of the returned BST matches the linked list values.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left.val <= node.val for node in traverse_preorder(return_value))
postconditions.description: The left subtree of each node contains only nodes with values less than or equal to the node's value.

postconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or node.right.val > node.val for node in traverse_preorder(return_value))
postconditions.description: The right subtree of each node contains only nodes with values greater than the node's value.
